text:
alex_chen: Hey @people-ops — I moved from NV to CA mid-Feb and just noticed my Feb 28 paycheck still shows NV state withholding. Can someone confirm which address Rippling has on file?

sarah (People Ops): Thanks for flagging, Alex. Can you DM me your new CA address? Also did you submit the CA Form DE-4 or a state W-4 equivalent?

alex_chen: Sent address via DM. I filled out the state section in Rippling under 'tax forms' on 2026-02-12 — screenshot attached. Looks like I selected "Nevada" by mistake on the dropdown at the time. :facepalm:

diego (Payroll): Hey team — I can see the payroll run for 2/25 drew state tax code NV for Alex. Because the change hit Rippling after payroll close (2/20 EOD for that cycle), it didn't make the run. We can correct it via an adjustment on next cycle or do an off-cycle correction. Which would you prefer?

alex_chen: Ideally I'd like the Feb withholding corrected now — I owe CA tax on that period. Off-cycle correction is fine if it avoids a tax gap. What does that look like?

diego (Payroll): Off-cycle correction will create an additional net-less deduction to adjust state tax withheld to CA rates. We'll include a note "state withholding correction: CA back-period" and show breakdown on your March paystub. It may show up as a separate line, not a retro paycheck.

sarah (People Ops): Also, FYI for everyone: if you change residence mid-cycle across states, please update Rippling and add a quick note in the change form so payroll knows to pull you into the current run. We can also accept the completed CA DE-4 PDF uploaded to your profile.

alex_chen: Filed CA DE-4 and uploaded it to Rippling just now. Link in case someone needs it: https://app.rippling.example/employee/axc/docs/DE-4 (internal)

diego (Payroll): Got it. I'll queue the off-cycle correction today. Expect an email confirmation from rippling-bot once the adjustment posts. Note: if you need a corrected year-to-date state withholding for tax filing earlier than Mar W-2 issuance, we can generate a supplemental statement.

ashley (HR-bot): Reminder: moving across states can affect benefits eligibility and SUI/SDI withholdings. Reach out to benefits@redwood if you haven't updated your plans.

alex_chen: Thanks all. One last Q — will this change affect my 2026 W-2 issuance or result in a separate state W-2?

diego (Payroll): It will reflect correctly on the 2026 W-2 for the state you were resident for the pay periods. If you have wages reported to multiple states (e.g., NV then CA), we may issue multiple state boxes on the same W-2 or a separate state W-2 depending on the state filing rules. I'll confirm after close, but we'll send a note before W-2 run and help with multi-state filings.

sarah (People Ops): Thanks, Diego. Alex — I'll follow up once the off-cycle posts and confirm any supplemental docs you might need before tax season. :thumbsup:

rippling-bot: Payroll adjustment created: ADJ-76342 for user alex_chen, type: state withholding correction, scheduled: 2026-03-03.

alex_chen: Appreciate the quick help — saved me a headache during tax season. :clap:
